name: Filosofija pustoj dushi
source:
Do you consider emotions an important part of life?
The answer itself is not as important - what matters is whether you truly believe what you say…

Max, the protagonist of this story, always considered emotions to be useless.
After the tragic death of his parents, he completely abandoned his humanity and began to exploit the kindness of others.
It was for this reason that he came to "Sovyonok", expecting to have a great time.

His plan was going smoothly until one moment when someone stronger than him appeared.
It was then that he felt all the emotions he had been running from.

Can the human mind endure so much information without breaking? Hard to say… Easier to show.

Power always comes with great responsibility - and not everyone is capable of bearing it.
